name: DeezNutz 404
fix_description: In _transfer, add early return or require(from != to) when sender equals recipient. Currently self-transfers cause rOwnedTo to overwrite rOwnedFrom (same storage slot), resulting in a net balance increase due to the reflect fee calculation being applied asymmetrically.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short flash-loan-assisted exploit with a very small number of actions: borrow WETH, buy the vulnerable token, abuse the token’s self-transfer logic repeatedly to inflate balance, then swap back and repay. Although it uses Balancer and Uniswap, the core bug is an obvious token transfer/accounting flaw and the PoC is concise and straightforward for an experienced auditor.
